title: Text alignment, decoration, transform, spacing
learningObjectives: Explain text alignment, decoration, transform, spacing and apply it in a readable interface.

understand.concept: Text properties control alignment, decoration, capitalization, and spacing. Common properties include text-align, text-decoration, text-transform, letter-spacing, and word-spacing. They change presentation, not the underlying text content.
understand.whyItMatters: text-transform can visually uppercase text without changing source text. Do not rely on visual capitalization alone to communicate meaning. Preserve recognisable link styling and sufficient spacing.
understand.analogy: These are finishing controls for text: they affect how words appear, not what the words mean.
understand.analogyLimit: The analogy builds intuition; actual rendering follows CSS layout rules and browser specifications.

explain.narrative: The label appears uppercase with extra letter spacing and an underline; the source text itself remains unchanged.
